Evidence / Notes: Record browser/version and viewport when executed.

Expected Result: Each selectable workspace opens the corresponding view; navigation remains usable and does not produce a blank screen.
Evidence / Notes: Do not describe role switching as authentication.

Scenario: Refresh after a supported member action
Preconditions: A member action with stated local-storage persistence has been performed

Expected Result: Observed state follows documented demo behaviour; data loss or local-only limitations are recorded accurately.
Evidence / Notes: Do not assume cross-device or secure persistence.

Expected Result: Roster and member profile render; displayed data remains clearly fictional.
Evidence / Notes: Do not enter real member data.

Preconditions: Trainer workspace provides a programme builder
Steps: 1. Open sample member. 2. Create/edit draft. 3. Add training days and exercise details. 4. Save as draft.
Expected Result: Draft can be created with entered sample values and remains distinguishable from a published plan.

Steps: 1. Open draft. 2. Change an exercise detail. 3. Save. 4. Reopen draft.
Expected Result: Saved draft shows the new value and does not silently revert to the old value.
Evidence / Notes: Record exact edited field.

Preconditions: A draft and publish/review action are available

Expected Result: Approved published plan is visible to intended demo member; unreviewed drafts are not presented as published.
Evidence / Notes: Prototype uses local storage; do not infer secure role controls.
